summary: First testing run for Searce MDM. Created /app/backend/tests/test_mdm_api.py — 16/16 pytest tests pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. UI smoke-tested with Playwright: hero, demo load -> configure -> strategy -> pipeline -> results -> SQL -> audit -> settings pages all render. Toggle/normalize/save flow on Configure works; backend correctly rejects probabilistic weights summing to 99 or 101 and accepts 100. Strategy endpoint returns summary + survivorship_breakdown + backend label via Emergent Gemini 3 Flash. Pipeline execution produces unique_masters>0 and duplicate_suspects>0 on the bundled 20-row demo dataset (cluster of John/Jon/Johnny Doe etc). 5 SQL layers generated and downloadable as plain-text blob.

ui_bugs.issue: In one Playwright run, clicking save-and-continue-btn while the 'Weights normalized to 100%' toast stack was visible did not navigate to /strategy/{jobId} (URL stayed on /configure/). Could be toast overlay intercepting clicks or stale state after rapid input edits. First test run navigated successfully. Possible flake — main agent should verify timing/disable button while saving and clear toasts.

issues: Page only polls /pipeline/status; this is correct because execution is triggered from Strategy page via [data-testid=confirm-execute-btn]. Documenting for next agent — direct deep-link to /pipeline/{jobId} without going through Strategy shows zeros until execution happens.

action_items: Verify Configure 'Save & Continue' reliably navigates to /strategy/{jobId} even when toasts are stacking. Consider awaiting axios response before navigate and showing a button loading state.

Consider auto-running /pipeline/execute on /pipeline/{jobId} mount if not yet executed (currently only Strategy page kicks it off). Otherwise add a banner/Execute button on the Pipeline page for deep-link entry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] (good — fails fast). Mongo _id is correctly excluded with {"_id":0} projections throughout. ✓
matching_engine.run_pipeline is O(N^2) — fine for preview/demo (20 rows) but will not scale; that's expected since real matching runs in BigQuery.
agent.py LLM call is wrapped in try/except with deterministic fallback — robust. backend label correctly toggles based on VERTEX_AI_CREDS_PATH.
Pipeline.jsx only polls status; if user deep-links to /pipeline/{jobId} without going via Strategy, page shows zeros indefinitely (no auto-execute fallback).
intent_save validates weight sum strictly == 100 with 0.01 tolerance — matches PRD requirement exactly.
All 13+ frontend interactive elements have data-testid attributes (excellent testability).
Frontend build emits some 404s in console (likely missing favicon/source map) — non-blocking but worth a quick check.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core flow works; one Save & Continue flake observed)

seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/demo/load which seeds 20 demo rows from /app/backend/configs/demo_customers.csv with known duplicates (John/Jon/Johnny Doe; Jane/Janet Smith; etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mdm_api.py — run with: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_mdm_api.py -v. Public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Demo job_id is generated each call. Configure page testids: match-deterministic-{col}, match-probabilistic-{col}, match-none-{col}, weight-slider-{col}, weight-input-{col}, survivorship-textarea-{col}, weight-total-badge, normalize-weights-btn, save-and-continue-btn. Strategy page: strategy-summary-callout, survivorship-breakdown-card, confirm-execute-btn, regenerate-strategy-btn.
